difficulty_reason: The proof introduces five location-sensitive critical-substring transformations and proves partial inverses through shifted-tail stability, then checks semistandardness by detailed adjacent-cell cases. A new lattice-walk invariant and circled mixed-insertion recording analysis preserve shifted dual equivalence, while the primed operator resolves the remaining two-row rectification ambiguity. These source-local constructions and the full case proofs exceed ordinary qualifying-exam tableau/crystal calculations and are retained with the final coplacticity argument.
